text:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm planning the release for feature/rollout v3.8.0 at 02:00 PT (UTC-7) tomorrow. Target duration 20m. Can CS/Marketing confirm release notes & comms? Also callout to eng-oncall for rollback readiness.

maya: We're good on support playbook. I'll paste the one-pager in #support before EOD. On-call runbook checked; escalation path unchanged. :white_check_mark:

jordan: Marketing assets queued. Publisher scheduled for 02:10 PT. Need the final one-line feature blurb from product by 18:00 PT.

alex: Blurb: "Reduced inference tail latency via adaptive batching and cache warm-up — up to 30% lower p95 for short prompts." Feel free to edit. -> tia please confirm this matches release notes.

tia: Looks accurate. Deployment plan: rolling across 3 shards, 10% -> 30% -> 100% every 5m. Smoke checklist:
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/redwood-inference-runtime -n prod
curl -sS https://internal-smoke/api/v1/health | jq .status
/opt/tools/smoke --pattern "generate_short_prompt" --iterations 50
```
I'll run the smoke job and post results in this thread.

sam: Oncall: I verified the rollback image tag is pinned and can be forced with:
```
./deployctl rollback --cluster prod --service inference --to-image=sha256:abc123
```
I'll be on standby during the window.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment job created for 1967890123 (02:00 PT). Canary plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100%. Timeout per phase: 5m.

jordan: Confirmed — communications scheduled to go live at 02:12 PT to avoid overlap with canary. We'll include support contact and short FAQs.

maya: Support playbook uploaded: https://confluence/redwood/releases/v3.8.0-playbook. Contact list: maya, sam, alex. I'll do a quick AM check-in 30m before deploy.

tia: Smoke run complete: all 50 iterations passed. Sample latency p95: 112ms. No errors. :thumbsup:

alex: Awesome. Final call: all teams +1? If no objections, proceeding as planned. @jordan @maya @sam

jordan: +1
maya: +1
sam: +1

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll kick the job at 02:00 PT and post status updates here. :rocket:
